# Pre-verify target artists to unfollow: followed but NOT in artists of liked songs
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Build lookup for following artists
following_lookup = {name: artist_id for (artist_id, name) in following_artists}
# Better lookup by id -> name
following_id_to_name = {artist_id: name for (artist_id, name) in following_artists}

unfollow_ids = sorted(list(following_artist_ids - liked_artist_ids))

verification_rows = []
for aid in unfollow_ids:
    name = following_id_to_name.get(aid, None)
    # Criterion: artist has not sung any liked song -> aid not in liked_artist_ids
    has_sung_liked = (aid in liked_artist_ids)
    verification_rows.append({'artist_id': aid, 'artist_name': name, 'in_liked_artists': has_sung_liked, 'action': 'unfollow'})

print('Task phrase:', 'Unfollow all the artists who have not sung even a single song I have liked on Spotify.')
print('Identity/source used:', 'Artists in show_liked_songs')
print('Following artists count:', len(following_artist_ids))
print('Liked-artist ids count:', len(liked_artist_ids))
print('Target unfollow count:', len(unfollow_ids))
print('Unfollow target verification table (must be in_liked_artists=False):')
for r in verification_rows:
    print(r)

# State-transition pre-check for unfollow: ensure each target id is currently followed
already_not_following = [aid for aid in unfollow_ids if aid not in following_artist_ids]
print('Already not following (should be empty):', already_not_following)
